description: This file contains a single exported function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of record objects related to cost data, grouping and organizing it for visualization purposes, specifically formatted for use with Recharts. It handles grouping by a specified dimension, dynamic sorting, and filling missing categories with zeroes.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw aggregate cost records into a structured dataset suitable for grouped bar charts, grouping by a specified secondary dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category'), with options for sorting and labeling.
